title: LTX 2.3 v2v extend - wire the proven bench workflow into the app as a Flow
description: Bench-proven single-stage video extend (comfy_workflows/raw/ltx_v2v_template.json, 56 nodes) runs end to end incl. silent sources + 3s foley. Ships as a FLOW, not a model op - no ModelDef, no supportedOps, no dep entries, /mpi-add-flow. BLOCKED on MPI-531 (FlowStepField is select|button|toggle only, so authoring it today needs a JS uiComponent that MPI-531 item 4 must then port). The old 1.4/MPI-450 blocker is SPENT - MPI-450 closed 2026-08-10. Work: restore Input_Width/Input_Height as MpiInt (a linked widget-input makes ComfyUI ignore the injected widget), fan to API via generate_ltx.py against 48188, then the FlowDef. Foley is MPI-536, lipsync MPI-537. See MPI-4 brief/validation.
